zh: 新增桌面宠物：在 Windows x64 上复用官方 Petdex 程序打开置顶窗口，跟随 DSH 启动与退出，主题或宠物变化时只重启 DSH 自己启动的实例；已有独立实例时明确报告而不接管。
en: Add a desktop pet: on Windows x64 the official Petdex player opens an always-on-top window that follows DSH's lifecycle, restarting only the instance DSH started when the theme or pet changes, and reporting an independent instance instead of adopting it.
